app.tagline: A desktop shell for the pi coding agent

noNode.title: Node.js is required
noNode.body: Pi Desktop needs Node.js ≥ {{min}} with npm. pi is installed via npm, so Node is a hard prerequisite.
noNode.detected: Detected Node.js v{{version}}, which is below the required v{{min}}.
noNode.notFound: Node.js was not found on your PATH.
noNode.npmNotFound: Detected Node.js v{{version}}, but npm was not found on your PATH or could not be run.

noPi.title: Install pi
noPi.body: Pi Desktop is a GUI shell: the agent runtime lives in your own environment. Install pi with npm — the only supported install method:
noPi.hint: Your config, sessions and keys live in ~/.pi/agent/ and stay yours. Pi Desktop never upgrades pi without you asking.

nonNpm.title: Switch pi to the npm install
nonNpm.body: Found pi v{{version}} at {{path}}, but it was not installed via npm. The desktop app can only embed an npm-installed pi for the full experience.
nonNpm.lossless: Switching is lossless: your config, sessions and keys in ~/.pi/agent/ are shared by every install method. The old binary is left untouched — remove it yourself if you want.
nonNpm.shadowed: An npm-installed pi (v{{version}}) already exists, but {{binPath}} comes first on your PATH. Adjust your PATH or remove the old binary, then re-check.

outdated.title: pi is too old
outdated.body: Found pi v{{current}}, but Pi Desktop requires ≥ v{{min}}.

incompatible.title: This pi installation is not compatible
incompatible.body: Pi Desktop found pi, but its public SDK is missing a required capability. You can keep your installation untouched or install the latest npm release to retry.

failed.title: Installation failed
failed.detail: The installer exited with an error. You can also run the command above in your terminal, then re-check.

status.compatibleUntested: This pi version has the required SDK capabilities but is outside the tested range. Pi Desktop will use it and report any runtime issue.

chat.placeholder: Message pi… (type @ for files, / for commands, drag & drop files; Enter to send)
chat.placeholderCmdEnter: Message pi… (type @ for files, / for commands, drag & drop files; ⌘Enter to send)
chat.queueSendTip: Follow up after the current task finishes

status.compactionDone: Context compacted: {{before}} → {{after}} tokens · summary request {{input}} in / {{output}} out

workspace.required: Pick a working directory for pi sessions first.

workspace.riskyRoot: The filesystem root cannot be used as a workspace. Pick a project directory instead.

command.includeContext: Excluded from context; click to include

errors.invalidKey: API key issue: the key may be invalid, expired or revoked — update it in provider settings.
errors.wrongModel: Model issue: the selected model is not available for this account — pick another model.
errors.upstream: Upstream issue: the request reached the server, but the provider's own upstream is failing. Retry later, or contact the provider with the request ID below.
errors.rateLimit: Rate limited: too many requests — wait a moment and retry.
errors.quota: Account quota or usage limit reached: contact the provider to top up or renew.
errors.network: Network issue: couldn't reach the provider. Check your network or proxy settings, then retry.
errors.timeout: Request timed out: the provider didn't respond in time. Please retry.
errors.stream: Stream interrupted: the connection was closed during generation. Please try again.
errors.unsupportedRelay: The provider does not support the Responses protocol (/v1/responses). Please switch the provider's adapter type to openai-completions (/v1/chat/completions) in Model Settings.
errors.replacementTimeout: Session replacement timed out without confirmation. Please retry or switch sessions.
errors.hostInvokeTimeout: Main-process communication timed out ({{action}}). Please retry.

models.title: Providers & Models
models.refreshCompleteWithDiscovery: Model catalogs refreshed. Found {{count}} custom models, including {{added}} new ones.
models.refreshMigratedProviders: Upgraded {{count}} provider(s) to the Responses protocol.
models.fieldBaseUrlHint: The provider's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, usually ending with /v1

apiHint.openai-responses: OpenAI Responses protocol, supports reasoning models
apiHint.openai-completions: Legacy Chat Completions protocol, used by most third-party APIs / OpenRouter
apiHint.anthropic-messages: Anthropic Messages protocol, for the official Anthropic API
apiHint.google-generative-ai: Google Generative AI protocol, for the official Gemini API

models.pricing: Per 1M tokens: input {{input}}, output {{output}}, cache read {{cacheRead}}, cache write {{cacheWrite}}
models.discoveryComplete: Key saved. Found {{count}} models, including {{added}} new ones.
models.discoveryFailed: Key saved, but model discovery failed: {{message}}
models.deleteProviderConfirm: Delete provider "{{name}}" together with all of its models and credentials? This cannot be undone.
models.editProviderDesc: Update display name, API base URL, or request adapter protocol for this provider.
models.oauthStarted: Authorization started — complete it in your browser.
models.addCustomDesc: Connect third-party APIs or local models compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google protocols.
models.fieldApiKeyHint: Access credential. Can be left blank for local keyless services (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM).
models.fieldModelsHint: Manually specify supported model IDs if undetected, separated by commas.
models.probeSectionDesc: Automatically detect supported models and recommended protocol, or verify connectivity.
models.unverifiedApi: Protocol could not be verified; choose the provider-compatible protocol
models.switchApiConfirm: Switch to {{api}}? The saved provider will use this protocol and its detected request URL.
models.probeListHint: Only fetches the model list; no generation request is sent.
models.verifyProtocolHint: Sends one minimal test request (~1 token) to confirm which request protocol the server supports. Optional.
models.probeRejectedHint: All protocol checks failed (common with gateway abuse-prevention filters or a wrong address). This does not mean the provider is unusable; if you know the model id, you can use it directly or enter it manually and save.
models.contextDetected: Detected a {{count}} token context from the provider
models.contextRequired: The provider did not report a context length; the 256K default will be used.
models.contextUsingDefault: No context was reported; the 256K context default will be used.
models.reasoningHint: Third-party models are treated as reasoning-capable by default so the thinking-depth menu stays available. Turn off only if the provider rejects thinking parameters.
models.imageSupportHint: Image input support is auto-detected from mainstream model specs. Adjust manually when the gateway drops image support or detection is off.
models.probeCatalogFailed: Could not fetch the model list: {{error}}. Make sure the server is running and the address/port is correct (open LM Studio first for local models).

sessions.exportFileNotFound: Exported file does not exist or has been removed

extensions.title: Packages
extensions.hint: Discover and manage extensions, skills, prompt templates, and themes through pi's native package manager.
extensions.searchPlaceholder: Search by package, description, or author
extensions.installedFilterEmpty: No installed packages match this search.
extensions.noReadme: This package does not publish a README.
extensions.cachedStale: Showing cached details because pi.dev is temporarily unavailable.
extensions.securityHint: Review the package details and source before installing. Pi Desktop delegates installation and removal to pi.
extensions.advancedInstallHint: Use a package source accepted by pi, including npm, git, or a local path.
extensions.upToDate: All packages are up to date.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.hint: MCP servers are provided by the pi-mcp-adapter extension. Config lives in <agentDir>/mcp.json (global) and <workspace>/.mcp.json (project); changes apply to the next session.
mcp.noAdapter: The pi-mcp-adapter extension is not installed. Configurations below only take effect once it is installed.
mcp.pendingReload: Configuration changed; it takes effect in the next session.

extui.unsupportedTui: An extension used a TUI-only capability that the desktop app does not support: {{feature}} (ignored)

skills.title: Skills
skills.readonlyHint: Skills are discovered and loaded by pi. You can toggle whether each skill enters the global system prompt (auto-detected vs manual only).
skills.noRuntime: Start a chat session first — skills are read from the active session.

mode.autoDesc: In system prompt; AI automatically loads instructions when relevant
mode.manualDesc: Out of system prompt (0 tokens); loads only when explicitly invoked via /skill:name

viewModal.manualExplanation: disable-model-invocation: true is declared in SKILL.md. This skill is omitted from the global system prompt (<available_skills>) with 0 token overhead, and will only load when explicitly invoked via /skill:{{name}}.
viewModal.autoExplanation: This skill's name and description are injected into the global system prompt (<available_skills>). The model will auto-detect and read its instructions when relevant.
viewModal.emptyInstructions: No additional instructions found in this skill.

batchOptimize.title: {{autoCount}} skills are currently in [Auto] mode and occupying global system prompt tokens. Consider setting specialized skills to [Manual Only] to invoke on-demand with /skill:name.

skills.importHint: Copy skills from Claude / Codex skill directories into this app (copied, not linked — they evolve independently).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tune your Pi Desktop experience

version.downloadFailedHint: Download failed. You can configure a GitHub download mirror (e.g. https://ghproxy.net/) below and retry.

downloadMirror.title: Download Mirror
downloadMirror.desc: GitHub download acceleration mirror prefix, e.g. https://ghproxy.net/

compaction.title: Context compaction
compaction.desc: Pi writes these native settings to ~/.pi/agent/settings.json.
compaction.enabledDesc: Allow pi to compact the active context when it approaches the limit.
compaction.reserveDesc: Trigger compaction when the context approaches its window limit.
compaction.keepRecentDesc: How much recent context to retain after compaction.
compaction.recommendation: Current model context window: {{window}} tokens. Keeping about 25% ({{tokens}} tokens) recent context is a useful starting point.
compaction.recommendationGeneric: For a large context window, keeping roughly 25% recent context is a useful starting point.

settings.followupBehaviorDesc: What Enter does during generation; Alt+Enter always does the opposite.
settings.sendWithDesc: With Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, plain Enter inserts a newline.
settings.preventSleepDesc: Keep the display awake while the agent is running (including auto-retry waits).
settings.notifyUiRequestDesc: Notify when an extension asks for confirmation or input (independent of the mode above).

trust.title: Project Trust
trust.desc: pi requires explicit trust for workspaces containing project-level .pi resources; changes take effect on the next session.

agentDefaults.title: Agent Defaults
agentDefaults.desc: These native settings are written to ~/.pi/agent/settings.json and apply to new sessions.

tools.title: Available tools
tools.desc: Built-in tools the model can call in new sessions. Core tools (read/bash/edit/write) are always enabled; read-only search tools (grep/find/ls) can be toggled. Changes apply to new sessions (the current session keeps the toolset from startup).

defaultThinking.title: Default thinking level
defaultThinking.desc: Initial thinking level for new sessions.

retry.title: Auto retry
retry.desc: pi automatically retries failed requests (rate limits / server errors).
retry.maxRetriesDesc: The turn ends with an error once exhausted.
retry.baseDelayDesc: Base wait between retries, growing with backoff.

proxy.title: Network proxy
proxy.desc: Pi Desktop proxy is enabled by default and uses the address below. Changes apply immediately. Turning it off connects directly and ignores system and pi proxy settings.
proxy.urlDesc: Auto mode uses this address; change it for your network.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.desc: System notification when a run finishes or an extension needs your confirmation or input.

review.title: Review
review.fallbackHint: Not a git repository — showing a read-only summary of files changed by the agent. Revert is unavailable.

mode.auto: Panel mode: Auto (dock when wide, overlay when narrow)
mode.overlay: Panel mode: Overlay (slides over without squeezing)

versionInstall.bodyMac: Click "Install and Quit" to open the disk image. Drag Pi Desktop to the Applications folder to replace the existing version, then restart.
versionInstall.bodyWin: Click "Install and Quit" to launch the installer and follow the setup wizard.
versionInstall.bodyLinux: The update package has been downloaded. Please view it in folder and replace manually.
